load_problem_from_id: load a realdata testbed problem by passing a problem_id string to problem_from_id
load_problem_from_config: load a testbed problem from a ProblemConfig object using problem_from_config
load_classification_problem: load a classification problem with train/test data, categorical KL estimator, and ECE metrics
load_regression_problem: load a regression problem with train/test data and Gaussian sample-based KL estimator
create_sample_based_testbed: create a SampleBasedTestbed with a RealDataSampler, sample-based KL, and prior knowledge
